full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media character study shows a young woman from the chest up against a warm gray paper ground. Her head tilts upward, eyes looking beyond the top edge, and dark unruly hair frames a pale face with a small vivid red mouth. Brown leather aviator goggles rest on her head above a narrow red band. She wears an open-collared vermilion shirt with loosely suggested sleeves and dark straps disappearing below the frame. The drawing is intentionally unfinished: gray rectangular paint patches sit behind her, thin construction lines cross the background, and broken black outlines extend beyond the hair and shoulders. Broad dark brush blocks shape the neck and under the jaw; pale cream strokes lift the nose, cheek, and brow. The red shirt is the main chromatic mass, interrupted by charcoal creases and occasional exposed paper. Lighting appears from above left, brightening the face while the neckline and shoulders become dark. The subject remains clear and emotionally charged even though the lower torso dissolves into sketch marks. This is a graphic painted study, with vigorous lines, rubbed pigment, and deliberate empty space around the silhouette. The overall feeling is restless and aspirational, held between precise facial focus and exploratory draftsmanship.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形混合媒材人物习作在暖灰纸底上呈现一位女性胸像。她仰起头，双眼望向画框上方，凌乱深发围着浅色面庞，嘴唇带一小点鲜红。棕色皮质飞行护目镜架在额上，下面是一道窄红带。她穿领口敞开的朱红衬衫，袖子画得松散，深色肩带消失在画面下缘。图像有意未完成：身后是灰色矩形颜料块，细构造线横过背景，断续黑轮廓越出头发和肩部。宽阔深色笔块塑出颈部和下颌，浅奶油色笔痕提亮鼻、颊和眉。红衬衫是主要彩色形块，被炭黑衣褶和偶尔裸露的纸面打断。光似从左上方来，照亮面部，领口与肩部转入深色。即使下方躯干融化为草图痕迹，主体仍清楚且富有情绪。这是一幅图形感绘画习作，有力线条、擦磨颜料和剪影周围有意留出的空白并存。整体躁动而向往，悬在准确面部焦点与探索性制图之间。
style_prompt_en: Expressive mixed-media drawing with broken black contours, broad opaque color blocks, exposed warm-gray paper, and visible searching construction lines. A single saturated vermilion mass contrasts with cream highlights and charcoal shadows. Edges alternate between precise small focal details and loose dissolved passages. Dry-brushed texture, layered rectangles, and asymmetrical negative space make the work feel energetic and unfinished in a deliberate way.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性混合媒材绘画，断续黑轮廓、宽阔不透明色块、裸露暖灰纸和可见的探索性构造线并存。单一饱和朱红色形块对照奶油色高光与炭黑阴影。边缘在准确的小范围焦点细节和松散融散区域之间交替。干刷肌理、层叠矩形与不对称留白形成有意未完成的活力。
theme_en: A red-shirted aviator looking upward in a rough character study
theme_zh: 粗笔人物习作中仰望的红衫飞行员
name: Rafael Albuquerque
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
